youtube_short.description: Half of American marriages end in divorce — and the financial damage goes way beyond lawyer fees. A prenup costs about $2,500 and can save you everything. Follow for more money truths they don't teach in school. #divorce #personalfinance #money #wealthbuilding #financetips
